notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: D0 (shared mob registry), D (trial spawners, vaults, lodestones, breezes), W (darkness, vibrations, sculk, warden), E1 and E2 (known limits), F (Elden Ring boss), later M1-M3 (remaining mobs). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL, even where a brief says to: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new enum variants, match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small. Record decisions in the track log.
